source.title: Ten Advances in Mathematics and Theoretical Computer Science
source.description_in_pdf_metadata: A collection of research papers by an internal model at OpenAI
source.policy: Refer to each new result as a manuscript claim until independent proof and publication review close. The displayed author and OpenAI-hosted URL establish source provenance, not peer review or correctness.

items.manuscript_claim: The exact asymptotic exponential rate of the Cohn-Elkies sphere-packing linear program and the corresponding Fourier sign-uncertainty constants are determined.
items.cas_tks_verdict: No direct CAS/TKS theorem follows. Auxiliary-function methodology may inspire bounds only after an explicit CAS metric, code, and reduction are defined.

items.manuscript_claim: Two-point linear-programming certificates improve asymptotic bounds for binary and spherical codes; Proposition 4.1 provides a conditional projection bound.
items.safe_subresult: For equal-rank orthogonal projectors, k(i,j)=tr(P_i P_j)/d is a normalized positive-semidefinite kernel with values in [0,1]. This follows directly from the Hilbert-Schmidt feature map and is a standard specialization.
items.critical_gap: The prior CAS transfer omitted Proposition 4.1's isometry/intertwining hypothesis: there must be an isometry B:V->W tensor V and unit vectors ell_x such that B*(ell_x tensor u)=sqrt(Lambda)u for every u in im(P_x), with Lambda>s. Projector rank and pairwise separation alone do not imply the capacity bound.
items.cas_tks_verdict: Projector similarity is a defensible experimental profile. Capacity language is forbidden until a CAS-specific B/intertwiner certificate and all code hypotheses are proved.
required_before_transfer: Direct PSD proof and standard-result label
Held-out empirical ablation for any representation claim

items.manuscript_claim: The unit group of the binary Leavitt algebra is non-sofic, giving an explicit counterexample to the soficity conjecture.
items.cas_tks_verdict: Relevant only to a future explicitly infinite group-based TKS model. It says nothing about the current finite typed calculus or open-simplex geometry without a formal reduction.
required_before_transfer: Definition of an infinite TKS group model
Proof that sofic approximation is the relevant property

items.manuscript_claim: Countably many pairwise nonisomorphic, mutually commensurable, finitely generated ICC property-(T) groups have isomorphic group von Neumann algebras.
items.cas_tks_verdict: Analogy only. Nonfaithfulness of Gamma->L(Gamma) does not imply non-identifiability for boards, C*-algebras, or topoi. A CAS result needs a defined source category, forgetful functor, equivalence relation, and CAS-specific counterexample or reconstruction theorem.
required_before_transfer: Verified scope relative to concurrent work

items.manuscript_claim: Exact formal computation of the n by n permanent over C requires Omega(n^2 log log n) gates for division-free arithmetic circuits and Omega(n^4/log n) variable leaves for formulas under the chapter's models.
items.cas_tks_verdict: Transfer is conditional on a CAS component computing the exact formal permanent and a bounded-cost compiler into the exact arithmetic model. It does not bound generic memory, latency, board size, approximate computation, branching, lookup, MUX, or finite-precision execution.

items.manuscript_claim: Every finite two-player one-round tensor-product entangled game has exponential all-coordinate parallel repetition with the chapter's explicit dependence on the one-copy gap and answer alphabet.
items.cas_tks_verdict: Ordinary prompt trials, adaptive models, communicating agents, correlated prompts, shared mutable state, or threshold acceptance do not satisfy the theorem. The postselection lemma also does not imply sheaf gluing.

items.manuscript_claim: A deterministic polynomial-time many-one reduction from 3SAT gives n^(1/400)-factor hardness for Euclidean GapCVP on full-rank square integer lattices.
items.cas_tks_verdict: Geometric analogy is insufficient. Fixed 39/40-dimensional state spaces, fixed codebooks, and special lattices do not inherit variable-dimension asymptotic NP-hardness.
required_before_transfer: Polynomial-time reduction from arbitrary GapCVP instances

items.manuscript_claim: A full-dimensional compact convex body in R^n whose barycenter is its only interior lattice point has ordinary Euclidean volume at most (n+1)^n/n!.
items.cas_tks_verdict: The substitution n=39 is algebraically correct only after all hypotheses hold. The current Noetic simplex is open, not compact; a compact affine body, covolume-normalized lattice, barycenter condition, and ordinary Euclidean volume must be specified. Fisher-Rao volume is not covered, and volume is not code cardinality without a counting theorem.

items.manuscript_claim: The multicolor triangle Ramsey number satisfies a superexponential lower bound of order k^(Theta(k)).
items.cas_tks_verdict: No immediate CAS theorem. Any capacity or diversity claim requires an exact graph/coloring encoding and a proof that the forbidden monochromatic-triangle condition represents the intended CAS constraint.

items.manuscript_claim: Separate bipartite graph constructions disprove compactness and degeneracy conjectures in extremal graph theory.
items.cas_tks_verdict: Counterexample methodology may motivate adversarial testing, but no board, topos, or Harness statement follows without a defined extremal-graph representation and transfer theorem.

independently_audited_background_candida.label: Finite transformation semigroups and Krohn-Rhodes
independently_audited_background_candida.safe_statement: Total endomaps of one fixed finite set generate a finite transformation semigroup, so powers are eventually periodic and idempotent behavior occurs. Typed inter-object maps instead require a finite category/path-category or explicit partial-transformation encoding.
nonclaims: Krohn-Rhodes reset-like factors are not literal CAS hardware reset gates.

independently_audited_background_candida.label: Markov-category modeling layer
independently_audited_background_candida.safe_statement: Markov categories provide a compositional language for stochastic maps; FinStoch is a canonical example.
nonclaims: The framework alone does not supply contraction, stationarity, calibration, causal identification, or sheaf gluing.

independently_audited_background_candida.label: Linear cellular-sheaf consistency and Laplacians
independently_audited_background_candida.safe_statement: For a finite-dimensional inner-product vector-space cellular sheaf, L=delta*delta, ker L=ker delta equals the global sections, and squared coboundary norm measures inconsistency; gradient flow converges to the orthogonal projection onto global sections.
nonclaims: A Markov-kernel-valued functor is not automatically a Hilbert-linear cellular sheaf.
A cellular sheaf on a face poset is not automatically a Grothendieck sheaf on Noetica.
